name: Two-step refactor
goal: Analyze one workspace file with a read-only agent, then apply the agreed edit in a second, isolated step and verify it.

analyze.description: Read-only analysis; proposes exactly one edit

prompt.text:
Apply exactly the change proposed below using edit_file. Do not make any other modification. Reply with the file path and a one-line description of the applied change.

{{analyze.output}}

verify.description: Optional read-only check of the result

prompt.text:
Re-read the edited file with read_file and confirm the change below is present and did not break the surrounding text. Reply with 'VERIFIED' plus one sentence, or describe the mismatch.

{{apply.output}}
